scenes.setting: Talim's pocket watch, blood-stained handkerchief, hair and notes delivered by a poor imitation of a postman — then a one-man performance for whoever may be watching: divinations that show only 'heart disease', pacing, a punch to his own head, and a long defeated silence
scenes.text_anchor: He punched himself in the head

scenes.setting: Midnight above the gray fog with the smuggled handkerchief (visions only: a blood-marked wooden puppet, a beautiful hand with a sapphire pinky ring, a black flame pressed to the puppet's heart): a curse indeed — and the repeat divination returns nothing at all, the same wall 0-08 once put up. The plan becomes: tell the prince he failed
scenes.text_anchor: What did Talim get himself involved in?

scenes.setting: Crown Cemetery, 9 a.m.: the coffin lowered past a swollen-eyed mother and trembling father, condolences with Mike and Aaron — then a veiled woman lays white flowers, her black gauze glove slipping to show a blue gem on her left pinky, and Klein's scalp goes numb
scenes.text_anchor: A blue gem faintly appeared on the pinky of her left palm.
